business_problem: Kongsberg Digital, part of Norway’s Kongsberg Group, develops software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions for heavy-asset industries like oil and gas, energy and maritime sectors. These are industries that often lag behind when it comes to digitization, something Kongsberg Digital with their 1,200 employees is helping them with.
solution_summary: Kongsberg Digital built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Agent Bricks. Kongsberg Digital, part of Norway’s Kongsberg Group, develops software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions for heavy-asset industries like oil and gas, energy and maritime sectors. These are industries that often lag behind when it comes to digitization, something Kongsberg Digital with their 1,200 employees is helping them with. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines builds transformation pipelines over shared data with Spark-based processing. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications.
